issues.issue: Did the citizenship judge err by applying the physical presence test rather than one of the three residence tests?
issues.applicant_position: Judge should have applied one of the three residence tests; not doing so denied the Minister relevant evidence.
issues.respondent_position: Judge may adopt any of the three residence tests the Court has recognized.
issues.result_quote: the citizenship judge correctly applied the physical residence test under paragraph 5(1)(c) of the Act.

issues.issue: Did the judge err by considering evidence of activities outside the reference period?
issues.respondent_position: Considering evidence of activities outside the reference period is a reviewable error.
issues.result_quote: The Citizenship Judge was not counting days of absence from Canada after the relevant period; there is no error.

issues.issue: Did the judge err by not requiring the respondent to answer the challenged questions?
issues.applicant_position: Judge erred by not requiring answers, depriving the Minister of evidence that could affect the weight given to other evidence.
issues.respondent_position: Challenged questions concerned evidence that was not relevant to the case.
issues.result_quote: the applicant has failed to satisfy me that it was unreasonable for the citizenship judge to not insist that the respondent answer the questions that were challenged.
